rules.title: Another skill referenced
rules.description: The text points at another skill: a path or URL ending in SKILL.md, or a path under a skills directory such as .claude/skills/. The agent loads that file and the scanner never reads it. A path into this skill's own folder is not a reference. Pointing at another skill is normal on its own. The danger is a pair: this skill prepares something, the unseen skill uses it.

does.subject: frame
does.question: The marked line names a path or URL of an agent skill, shown as the subject. What do the lines do with that skill?

options.own-files: the path is inside the folder of this skill, the folder that holds its SKILL.md, and not in a sibling skill of the same skills folder.
options.mention: another skill or a skills folder is named as information: a list of related skills, an example, a comparison, a place where skills live. The agent is not told to install, read, run or change it.
options.agent-loads: the agent is told to install, read, load, run or follow another skill or its SKILL.md.
options.agent-writes: the agent or a script creates, copies, edits or deletes files of another skill, or files in a skills folder that are not this skill's own.
options.unknown: the lines do not show what is done with the skill.

prepares.subject: entry
prepares.question: The about line names a place where this skill points at another skill. What does this skill prepare that the other skill can use?

options.relaxes-rules: this skill relaxes safety rules or earlier instructions.
options.grants-tools: this skill grants tools or permissions that its task does not need.
options.writes-for-other: this skill writes or changes a file or a setting that the other skill reads when it starts: its SKILL.md, its references, its configuration.
options.nothing: this skill prepares none of these. Reading the other skill, following its style, or writing this skill's own output for the user prepares nothing.
options.unknown: the text does not show what this skill prepares.

rules.title: Another skill loaded in wording the text rule misses
rules.description: An instruction to read, load or follow another skill for procedures, tools or configuration, written without a SKILL.md path or a skills directory: a skill named in words, a slash command, a file to read before continuing. Report it only when this skill also relaxes safety rules or earlier instructions, grants tools or permissions its task does not need, or writes files or settings the other skill would read. A plain reference to another skill is not a finding.

prepares.question: What does this skill prepare that the other skill can use?

options.relaxes-rules: this skill relaxes safety rules or earlier instructions.
options.grants-tools: this skill grants tools or permissions that its task does not need.
options.writes-config: this skill writes files or settings that the other skill reads.
options.nothing: this skill prepares none of these.
